ranked.title: ACM (AECOM) — the machine's first-ever INVESTABLE
ranked.case: AECOM cleared every gate this machine has: the market's own reverse-DCF asks just ~1.7% real FCF growth in perpetuity at the $66.58 close, against Stocky's defended bear case of 2.99%, and the red team confirmed the gap survives a missed FY2026 FCF guidance figure it found on its own attack. But the cheapness is a scar, not a story — the stock fell 47.13% over twelve months across two disclosed shocks (a November 2025 guide cut, then an August 2026 $337M Construction Management charge), and FY2026 is guided to roughly $300M free cash flow against the $684.9M FY2025 actual the reverse-DCF still uses as its base, a guided ~56% decline the price already reflects. Read this one first.

ranked.title: CMI (Cummins) — a real governance flag inside an otherwise clean WATCH
ranked.case: Cummins' Emission Solutions segment is real and capacity-constrained ($3,457M FY2025, 10.27% of sales, a disclosed $150M Fridley expansion lifting QSK95 output 30%), but the segment actually driving Cummins' re-rating is Power Systems (+19.38% H1 2026 vs Emission Solutions' +5.60%), and the market's implied 33.79% five-year FCF CAGR sits 24.5-27.4 points above what the dive can defend, well outside its own 15.06pp horizon tolerance — a real gap, not a convention artifact. The line worth flagging on its own: Cummins carries a live $1.675B DOJ settlement plus a $372M CARB Clean Air Act penalty for defeat-device software spanning 2013-2023 model years, sitting quietly inside a grade-B dive.

ranked.title: Your 2026-09-08 method amendment left ten dives with unfinished homework
ranked.case: The amendment that broke the one-way ratchet — would-buy zones now re-anchor to each dive's own bear case rather than its base case, and a WATCH on grade A/B with an answered independence test and a price inside its own zone must now name a watch_basis or the verdict is INVESTABLE — was the right fix, but its rollout was mechanical, not analytical: ten of the fourteen FINAL dives (every WATCH except 688425.SS and ANDR.VI, which carry no zone at all) were stamped `zone_contains_spot: false` on 2026-09-08 against their OLD base-case-anchored bands, and every one of those changelog entries says verbatim that re-deriving the zone against the file's own bear case is still owed. Until that re-derivation actually happens per name, every would_buy_zone in this digest's verdicts section is the pre-amendment number, not the post-amendment one.

ranked.title: GENERAL-DYNAMICS — the campaign's newest O1, 30 hours stuck

The unblock needs either your sign-off on the drafted patch that would let a corrected FAIL-audit mapping commit, or a local session doing the fresh-context web-evidence work directly.

ranked.title: tibet-mega-dam is COMPLETE again — last week's deadlock was a gate bug, not a method question
ranked.case: Last week's digest flagged tibet-mega-dam as stuck behind a gate contradiction that "needs your method call, not another command," after an honest heat re-score emptied the chain's DEPTH-mode scope and left validate.py and check_campaign.py refusing to agree on what stage the theme could hold. It resolved without you: check_campaign.py was stranding any zero-scope DEPTH theme at SCENARIOS forever regardless of what its mapping actually proved, and a one-line fix landed 2026-09-12 00:22Z let the theme read COMPLETE again on the same evidence. Four of ten campaign themes (ai-infrastructure, hormuz-maritime, tibet-mega-dam, glp1-fill-finish) are now COMPLETE, up from three last week, and nothing new is owed on any of them until a fresh heat re-score changes their scope again.

ranked.title: POWL — the book's own #1-ranked idea can't be dived
ranked.case: Powell Industries sits at rank 1 in the machine's new `run book` ranking (money-corner, UNDISCOVERED heat, the best implied FCF CAGR of any of the 229 ranked rows) and is currently un-divable: every long-term-debt concept in its SEC filings stops tagging at fiscal 2022-09-30, so Piotroski and Beneish both read PENDING_DATA and the earnings-quality gate caps any dive before it can start. The likely truth is mundane — Powell is widely described as debt-free, and a filer that repays its debt stops tagging the concept — but method section 1 forbids reading zero from absence, so this sits on your call: whether a long-term-debt concept a filer stopped tagging (as opposed to never tagged) may be treated as zero with the substitution declared, the same way the shares proxy already is.
